title: Culiatum Economy
description: Adds copper, silver, gold, and Culiatum coins for item-based economy on Fabric 1.21.11.
body:
# Culiatum Economy
This mod adds four physical coin denominations to Fabric 1.21.11:

- Copper Coin
- Silver Coin
- Gold Coin
- Culiatum Coin

The mod is designed as a lightweight base for item-based economy systems, especially for servers using NPC trading mods such as Easy NPC.

## Features:
- Custom coin items with unique textures
- Culiatum Coin reserved as a premium currency
- Config file to enable or disable crafting recipes
- Fabric and JEI-friendly setup
